item.title: Legal Hackers
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Legal Hackers

https://legalhackers.org/

Legal Hackers is a global movement of lawyers, policymakers, designers, technologists, and academics who explore and develop creative solutions to some of the most pressing issues at the intersection of law and technology. Through local meetups, hackathons, and workshops, Legal Hackers spot issues and opportunities where technology can improve and inform the practice of law and where law, legal practice, and policy can adapt to rapidly changing technology.

item.title: How to Sync Issues to/from Mirror Repo?
item.author: emecas
item.description:
How to Sync Issues to/from Mirror Repo?

Comment on 2020-02-13:
github

curl -i “https://api.github.com/repos/<repo-owner>/<repo-name>/issues” -u “<user-name>”

curl -i “https://api.github.com/repos/emecas/commitit/issues” -u “emecas”

gitlab

https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/issues.html

curl --header “PRIVATE-TOKEN: <your_access_token>” https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4/issues

New Issue:

https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/issues.html#new-issue

POST /projects/:id/issues

curl --request POST --header “PRIVATE-TOKEN: <your_access_token>” https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4/projects/4/issues?title=Issues%20with%20auth&labels=bug

Comments on issues

https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/issues.html#comments-on-issues

Comments are done via the notes resource

https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/notes.html

Create new issue note
